name: net_tab_back_without_resync_hashes_again
description: Two seats. Client 2's tab hides for 240 frames early in the match, before any checkpoint past its last hash is kept, so shown again and about 240 ticks behind it says catching_up, holds its HASHes and catches up from the turns it buffered, and no RESYNC answers: the sequencer has nothing further on to send. The hold ends once the server's answer is known, when the turn its PONG named arrives with no RESYNC before it: then its HASHes go out again, and they agree with client 1's.

steps.msg: shown again and behind, it said catching_up
it caught up from the turns it buffered, and no RESYNC came
with no RESYNC to wait for, its HASHes go out again
